prompts.title: Fashion Editorial Scrapbook Collage AI Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo only as the facial identity reference. Preserve the subject’s recognizable facial features, face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle/hair texture, age, gender, and overall likeness. Ignore the original pose, clothing, background, framing, and lighting.

Create a premium fashion scrapbook / editorial collage portrait in a vertical 2:3 composition, featuring the same subject repeated throughout the design.

The main subject appears as a large full-body color cutout in the foreground, positioned slightly left of center and extending from near the upper-middle area to the bottom of the frame. The subject stands naturally facing the camera with a relaxed confident expression, one arm resting naturally beside the body and the other lightly holding the shoulder-bag strap. Keep realistic body proportions and a polished fashion-catalog pose.

Dress the subject in a stylish coral-red puff-sleeve peplum top, high-waisted light blue relaxed wide-leg jeans, and chunky cream/off-white open-toe sandals. Add a small cream crossbody/shoulder bag with a long strap, decorated with a cute embroidered red flower and subtle botanical details. Keep the wardrobe realistic, neat, youthful, and coordinated.

Give the foreground cutout a thick clean white sticker-style outline, followed by a very subtle soft shadow so it appears layered above the background collage.

BACKGROUND COLLAGE

Create four large horizontal rounded-rectangle photo panels, stacked vertically with equal spacing on a clean white background. Each panel should have softly rounded corners and contain a different black-and-white studio portrait of the exact same subject.

Keep all four background portraits monochrome with a smooth light-gray studio backdrop, subtle gradient lighting, soft shadows, and elegant fashion-editorial photography.

Use these poses:

Top panel: chest-up portrait wearing round dark sunglasses, one hand gently touching/adjusting the sunglasses, composed expression.
Second panel: upper-body portrait wearing the same sunglasses, head slightly tilted, lips slightly parted, relaxed fashion pose.
Third panel: upper-body portrait wearing sunglasses, one hand gently resting against the cheek, calm thoughtful expression.
Bottom panel: upper-body portrait wearing sunglasses, relaxed front-facing pose with a very subtle soft smile.

Keep the hairstyle consistent across all five appearances of the subject. The sunglasses should be classic small-to-medium round dark-lens fashion sunglasses, not oversized or futuristic.

COMPOSITION

The colorful full-body subject must overlap portions of the second, third, and fourth monochrome panels, creating strong foreground depth. Keep enough of every black-and-white portrait visible so the collage remains recognizable. Maintain clean white gaps between each rounded panel.

Use a bright pure-white outer background, minimal clutter, subtle realistic shadows, polished magazine-layout spacing.

IMAGE QUALITY

Ultra-clean premium fashion editorial, realistic skin texture, natural hands and fingers, accurate anatomy, sharp facial details, detailed fabric texture, realistic denim folds, realistic embroidered bag, clean cutout edges, soft professional studio lighting, high-resolution photography, sophisticated Pinterest-style aesthetic.

Important: every portrait and the foreground figure must clearly depict the same person with consistent identity. Do not create different faces, duplicate limbs, distorted hands, extra accessories, text, logos, or additional people. Do not change the subject’s age or gender.

prompts.title: Man in Tailored Suit Posed on Black Cube
prompts.prompt:
Create a 8k ultra-high detailed photograph of a stylish man in a suit. He has neatly styled hair and a well-groomed appearance.
Composition:
A full-body shot of the man is positioned slightly off-center to the right, balanced against the dark, featureless studio background. The pose is dynamic, with the subject standing while his left leg is resting on a simple, matte black geometric cube. The camera is eye-level, framing the man's expression and full attire.
Outfit:
The man is dressed in a expertly tailored, textured slate-blue wool suit. This is paired with a crisp white collared dress shirt and a dark navy, slim-width tie. He wears dark black socks and polished tan-brown leather oxford dress shoes, which rest on the black cube. The cuffs of his white shirt are subtly visible beneath the suit jacket sleeves.
Pose:
The man stands confidently, his left foot resting flat on the black block. His arms are crossed, hands resting naturally on his raised left knee. The stance is assertive and masculine, with his right leg straight and supportive. He is angled slightly towards the left.
Expression:
He has a serious, contemplative, and focused expression. He is looking slightly to the left, just out of the frame.
Background:
The setting is a minimalist, professional studio environment. The background features a seamless, solid dark charcoal-grey infinity wall, where the backdrop and floor merge smoothly into one continuous surface. A subtle radiant glow and soft vignette effect add depth to the scene, naturally drawing attention to the subject.
Lighting:
The scene is lit with soft, directional studio light from the front-right. This illumination clearly defines the textures of the wool suit, the leather shoes, and the crisp white shirt, while casting subtle, natural shadows that enhance the depth of his features and the folds in his clothing.
Camera Angle and Technical Details:
The photograph is a high-resolution, sharp shot taken with a digital camera (e.g., Canon EOS 5D Mark IV) and a prime lens (50mm f/1.8). A clean, low-grain look.  Shallow depth of field, Sharp focus on the man and the foreground object. Ultra-detailed image quality, highlighting the suit fabric texture and leather shoe grain.
Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Dreamy Birthday Bliss
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as an reference for the girl’s face, hair & identity.  Do not alter facial features.
A full-body portrait of a reference cute girl standing beside a birthday cake at a themed party, centered in a soft, dreamy indoor studio setting.
The theme is fully inspired by Hello Kitty, with a color palette of soft pink, white, and red, with subtle pastel accents.
The child has a sweet smile, and hair styled in an elegant updo with soft curls framing her face.
She is wearing a luxurious, sparkling dress in white and soft pink tones, with delicate lace details, glitter textures, and Hello Kitty character patterns printed across the fabric.
The dress features a semi-transparent lace neckline and sleeves, with a flared skirt decorated with bows, hearts, and subtle shimmering particles.
She also wears a decorative headband featuring Hello Kitty ears with a signature red bow and a small elegant tiara detail.
On her feet are white lace knee-high socks and glossy red shoes with bow details.

She stands in an elegant, natural pose: her body is slightly angled (~15–20°) and not fully frontal. Her weight is shifted onto one leg, while the other leg is placed slightly forward in a gentle cross-over stance. Her posture is upright but soft with relaxed shoulders, and her head is slightly tilted toward the camera. One arm hangs relaxed by her side with a slight natural bend, while her other hand softly rests on the cake stand.
Next to her on a classic, matte white pedestal stand resting a tall, three-tier birthday cake in pink and white gradient tones, decorated with bows, hearts, stars, and multiple Hello Kitty figurines.
The cake topper shows a number “7” candle.On the front of the cake, a decorative plaque reads: “Happy Birthday” in elegant script.
The background is filled with a festive balloon arrangement in pink, white, and red, forming an arch above her.
Hanging across the backdrop is a triangular banner with Hello Kitty faces and patterns.
Warm fairy string lights glow softly behind, creating a magical bokeh effect.
Light fog or mist surrounds the lower area, adding a dreamy atmosphere.
Around the scene are multiple Hello Kitty plush toys placed on the floor and small stools, reinforcing the theme.
The floor is light wood, and the lighting is soft, warm, and diffused, enhancing the child’s face and the sparkle of her outfit.
At the floor, add a beautiful greeting card with the text: “Prompt Plum” in a decorative style.
